title.suggested: Allen and others renew bonds after Flint-McManus fight indictment

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen and four others, arrested over the Flint-McManus fight, were indicted by a Franklin County grand jury and renewed their bonds before Judge Noonan.

facts.fact: Allen, with Tom Kelly, Jake Esher, Jim Sweeney and T. J. Tucker, was indicted by the Franklin County grand jury over the Flint-McManus fight
Allen renewed his bond before Judge Noonan after the indictment
